name: tvshows
label: How often R watches TV drama or sitcoms

questions.text:
I'll now ask about some different kinds of television shows. Would you tell me how often you watch prime-time drama or situation comedy programs?  Would you say every day, several times a week, several times a month, rarely, or never? 
A. Prime-time drama or situation comedy programs.
